spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan
# set scan size 10 µm x 10 µm
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
# set resolution (points per line and lines per frame)
scan.Points = 256
scan.Lines = 256
# optional: set center position to 0,0
scan.CenterPosX = 0.0
scan.CenterPosY = 0.0
# start scan (upwards)
scan.StartFrameUp()
# wait until scanning finishes
while scan.IsScanning:
    print(f"Scanning... line {scan.Currentline}/{scan.Lines}")
    time.sleep(2)
print('Scanning finished')
# after scan, the image is typically saved; try to retrieve path
# some APIs expose the last saved image path via scan.ImagePath or similar attribute
image_path = getattr(scan, 'ImagePath', None)
if not image_path:
    # fallback: look for recent files in current directory with common image extensions
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    candidates = []
    for f in os.listdir(cwd):
        if f.lower().endswith(('.tif', '.tiff', '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg')):
            candidates.append(os.path.join(cwd, f))
    if candidates:
        # pick the most recent by modification time
        image_path = max(candidates, key=os.path.getmtime)
print('Image path:', image_path)
# clean up
